# discord_role_permissions (Data Source)

Reads the permissions a role grants together with `@everyone`, as Discord computes them. Other roles and member-specific overwrites are not included. When `channel_id` is set, the channel's permission overwrites are applied; threads use their parent channel's overwrites. Reading a channel requires the bot to have `VIEW_CHANNEL` there, and `CONNECT` as well in voice and stage channels. See [Get Guild Role Permissions](https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/guild#get-guild-role-permissions) and [Get Channel Role Permissions](https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/channel#get-channel-role-permissions).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_role" "moderators" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  name      = "Moderators"
}

# What the role grants across the server, together with @everyone.
data "discord_role_permissions" "moderators" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  role_id   = data.discord_role.moderators.id
}

# What the role grants in one channel, after the channel's overwrites for
# @everyone and the role. implicit = false keeps permissions that Discord
# would otherwise mask because the role cannot view the channel.
data "discord_role_permissions" "moderators_staff" {
  server_id  = var.server_id
  role_id    = data.discord_role.moderators.id
  channel_id = var.staff_channel_id
  implicit   = false
}

output "moderator_permissions" {
  value = data.discord_role_permissions.moderators.permission_names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) ID of the role.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

- `channel_id` (String) ID of a channel or thread to compute the permissions in. Omit for server-level permissions.
- `implicit` (Boolean) Whether Discord masks the permissions that a missing `VIEW_CHANNEL`, or a missing `CONNECT` in a voice or stage channel, makes unusable (see [implicit permissions](https://docs.discord.com/developers/topics/permissions#implicit-permissions)). Requires `channel_id`. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `permission_names` (Set of String) Names of the permission flags set in `permissions`, such as `VIEW_CHANNEL`. Flags this provider does not know are omitted.
- `permissions` (String) The computed permissions as a decimal bitfield string.
